facts.text: A citizen sneaks into Diamond City and brings human citizens to the Mushroom Kingdom.
The human citizens are kept around so they can either be cloned for food or birth more humans.
Wario profited off the fear and confusion of the citizens.
Wario sold bogus mushroom repellants to the citizens.
Wario was placed inside the clone machine.
Rosalina comes to visit the Mushroom Kingdom from her Comet Observatory.
Rosalina is shocked at what the Mushroom Kingdom has become.
Some citizens were out of the kingdom during the cleansing.
Some citizens were still ravenous after being out of the kingdom during the cleansing.
